quests.question: A journalist reports true news stories, while an author usually writes whole books, often about made-up stories.
quests.hint: A journalist reports true news stories, while an author usually writes whole books, often about made-up stories.
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a journalist. Journalists research and write news stories for newspapers or TV.
quests.funFact: A journalist checks facts carefully before sharing a story.
quests.wordExample: The journalist interviewed the mayor about the new park.

quests.question: A composer writes original music, while a musician performs music by playing an instrument.
quests.hint: A composer writes original music, while a musician performs music by playing an instrument.
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a composer. Composers write original music for others to play or sing.
quests.funFact: A composer can hear a whole song in their head before writing a single note!
quests.wordExample: The composer wrote a cheerful new song for the choir.

quests.question: A zookeeper cares for animals living at the zoo, while a marine biologist studies animals living in the ocean.
quests.hint: A zookeeper cares for animals living at the zoo, while a marine biologist studies animals living in the ocean.
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a zookeeper. Zookeepers feed and care for animals living at the zoo.
quests.funFact: A zookeeper learns exactly what food every animal needs to stay healthy.
quests.wordExample: The zookeeper fed fresh fruit to the elephants.

quests.question: A journalist reports true news stories, while an author usually writes whole books, often about made-up stories.
quests.hint: A journalist reports true news stories, while an author usually writes whole books, often about made-up stories.
quests.explanation: Correct! This is a journalist. Journalists research and write news stories for newspapers or TV.
quests.funFact: Some journalists travel to faraway places to report on important events.
quests.wordExample: The journalist wrote a story about the school's science fair.

quests.question: A mechanic fixes engines and vehicles, while an electrician fixes wires and electricity.
quests.hint: A mechanic fixes engines and vehicles, while an electrician fixes wires and electricity.
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a mechanic. Mechanics fix cars and other machines that stop working.
quests.funFact: A mechanic can often tell what's wrong with a car just by listening to it.
quests.wordExample: The mechanic fixed the flat tire on our car.

quests.question: A chemist studies how different substances mix and react, while a general scientist may study many different subjects.
quests.hint: A chemist studies how different substances mix and react, while a general scientist may study many different subjects.
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a chemist. Chemists mix and test chemicals to make new discoveries.
quests.funFact: A chemist mixes tiny amounts of different substances to see what happens!
quests.wordExample: The chemist mixed two liquids carefully in the lab.

quests.question: A weaver crosses threads together to make cloth, while a tailor sews and fixes clothes so they fit just right.
quests.hint: A weaver crosses threads together to make cloth, while a tailor sews and fixes clothes so they fit just right.
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a weaver. Weavers cross threads together on a loom to make cloth.
quests.funFact: Weavers use a tool called a loom to cross threads together.
quests.wordExample: The weaver made a warm blanket from soft wool.

quests.question: A personal trainer helps one person exercise and get fit, while a coach teaches and guides a whole sports team.
quests.hint: A personal trainer helps one person exercise and get fit, while a coach teaches and guides a whole sports team.
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a personal trainer. Personal trainers help one person exercise safely and reach their fitness goals.
quests.funFact: A personal trainer plans a different workout just for each person!
quests.wordExample: The personal trainer counted while I lifted the weights.

quests.question: An illustrator draws the pictures in a book, while an author writes the words of the story.
quests.hint: An illustrator draws the pictures in a book, while an author writes the words of the story.
quests.explanation: Yes! This is an illustrator. Illustrators draw the pictures that appear inside books.
quests.funFact: An illustrator might draw dozens of pictures for just one storybook!
quests.wordExample: The illustrator drew a colorful picture of the dragon.

quests.question: A weaver crosses threads together to make cloth, while a tailor sews and fixes clothes so they fit just right.
quests.hint: A weaver crosses threads together to make cloth, while a tailor sews and fixes clothes so they fit just right.
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a weaver. Weavers cross threads together on a loom to make cloth.
quests.funFact: A weaver can turn plain thread into cloth with beautiful patterns!
quests.wordExample: The weaver crossed the colorful threads on her loom.

quests.question: A flight attendant helps passengers during the flight, while a pilot flies the airplane from the cockpit.
quests.hint: A flight attendant helps passengers during the flight, while a pilot flies the airplane from the cockpit.
quests.explanation: Yes! This is a flight attendant. Flight attendants help passengers stay safe and comfortable on an airplane.
quests.funFact: A flight attendant is trained to help everyone stay calm in an emergency.
quests.wordExample: The flight attendant showed us where the exits were.

quests.question: An author writes and publishes whole books, while a writer writes many kinds of things, like stories, songs, or articles.
quests.hint: An author writes and publishes whole books, while a writer writes many kinds of things, like stories, songs, or articles.
quests.explanation: Yes! This is an author. Authors write books for people to read and enjoy.
quests.funFact: An author might spend more than a year writing just one book!
quests.wordExample: The author signed copies of her new book.

quests.question: A ship captain leads the whole crew and steers the ship, while a sailor works aboard the ship as part of the crew.
quests.hint: A ship captain leads the whole crew and steers the ship, while a sailor works aboard the ship as part of the crew.
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a ship captain. Ship captains lead the crew and steer a ship across the sea.
quests.funFact: A ship captain is responsible for everyone and everything on board!
quests.wordExample: The ship captain steered the ship safely into port.

quests.question: A singer uses their voice to make music, while a musician plays an instrument like a guitar or drums.
quests.hint: A singer uses their voice to make music, while a musician plays an instrument like a guitar or drums.
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a singer. Singers use their voice to perform songs.
quests.funFact: Singers warm up their voice before a show, just like athletes stretch!
quests.wordExample: The singer performed her new song on stage.

quests.question: A security guard watches over one place, like a store, while a police officer keeps a whole neighborhood safe.
quests.hint: A security guard watches over one place, like a store, while a police officer keeps a whole neighborhood safe.
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a security guard. Security guards watch over a place and keep people and things safe.
quests.funFact: Security guards keep a careful eye on one place, like a museum or store.
quests.wordExample: The security guard greeted everyone who walked into the building.

quests.question: A ship captain leads the whole crew and steers the ship, while a sailor works aboard the ship as part of the crew.
quests.hint: A ship captain leads the whole crew and steers the ship, while a sailor works aboard the ship as part of the crew.
quests.explanation: Correct! This is a ship captain. Ship captains lead the crew and steer a ship across the sea.
quests.funFact: Ship captains study maps and weather carefully before every voyage.
quests.wordExample: The ship captain checked the map before the long voyage.

quests.question: A botanist studies plants scientifically to understand how they grow, while a gardener plants and takes care of flowers in a yard or park.
quests.hint: A botanist studies plants scientifically to understand how they grow, while a gardener plants and takes care of flowers in a yard or park.
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a botanist. Botanists study plants and how they grow.
quests.funFact: Botanists study how plants use sunlight, water, and soil to grow.
quests.wordExample: The botanist explained how the plant makes its own food.

quests.question: An architect draws the plan for a building, while a construction worker actually builds it.
quests.hint: An architect draws the plan for a building, while a construction worker actually builds it.
quests.explanation: Well done! This is an architect. Architects design buildings before workers start to build them.
quests.funFact: An architect draws a careful plan before a single brick is placed!
quests.wordExample: The architect drew the plan for a new library.

quests.question: An interpreter translates spoken words as people are talking, while a translator changes written words from one language into another.
quests.hint: An interpreter translates spoken words as people are talking, while a translator changes written words from one language into another.
quests.explanation: Yes! This is an interpreter. Interpreters listen in one language and speak the meaning in another right away.
quests.funFact: An interpreter has to think and translate at almost the same time someone is speaking!
quests.wordExample: The interpreter helped the visitor understand the doctor's questions.

quests.question: A musician plays an instrument to make music, while a singer uses their own voice to sing.
quests.hint: A musician plays an instrument to make music, while a singer uses their own voice to sing.
quests.explanation: Yes! This is a musician. Musicians play instruments to create music.
quests.funFact: A musician might practice one song hundreds of times before a show!
quests.wordExample: The musician played a cheerful tune on his guitar.

quests.question: A pharmacist prepares and explains medicine, while a doctor examines you and decides what medicine you need.
quests.hint: A pharmacist prepares and explains medicine, while a doctor examines you and decides what medicine you need.
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a pharmacist. Pharmacists prepare medicine and explain how to take it safely.
quests.funFact: Pharmacists check every prescription carefully to make sure it's safe.
quests.wordExample: The pharmacist explained how many times a day to take the medicine.

quests.question: An interpreter translates spoken words as people are talking, while a translator changes written words from one language into another.
quests.hint: An interpreter translates spoken words as people are talking, while a translator changes written words from one language into another.
quests.explanation: Great job! This is an interpreter. Interpreters listen in one language and speak the meaning in another right away.
quests.funFact: Some interpreters work at big meetings with people from many countries.
quests.wordExample: The interpreter repeated the speech in a different language.

quests.question: A sculptor shapes solid material like stone or metal into 3-D art, while a potter shapes soft clay into bowls and cups.
quests.hint: A sculptor shapes solid material like stone or metal into 3-D art, while a potter shapes soft clay into bowls and cups.
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a sculptor. Sculptors carve or shape material like stone or metal into art.
quests.funFact: A sculptor can spend months carefully carving a single statue!
quests.wordExample: The sculptor carved a statue from a block of stone.

quests.question: A detective searches for clues and solves mysteries, while a police officer keeps neighborhoods safe every day.
quests.hint: A detective searches for clues and solves mysteries, while a police officer keeps neighborhoods safe every day.
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a detective. Detectives look for clues and solve mysteries.
quests.funFact: Detectives write down every clue so they don't forget a single detail.
quests.wordExample: The detective figured out the mystery of the missing bicycle.

quests.question: A vet is a doctor for animals, while a farmer grows crops and raises animals for food.
quests.hint: A vet is a doctor for animals, while a farmer grows crops and raises animals for food.
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a vet. Vets take care of sick or hurt animals.
quests.funFact: A vet might care for a tiny hamster and a huge horse on the same day!
quests.wordExample: We took our puppy to the vet for its check-up.

quests.question: A butcher prepares and sells meat, while a chef cooks meat and other food into finished meals.
quests.hint: A butcher prepares and sells meat, while a chef cooks meat and other food into finished meals.
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a butcher. Butchers cut and prepare meat to sell at a shop.
quests.funFact: A butcher learns many different ways to cut meat for cooking.
quests.wordExample: The butcher wrapped the meat carefully for my mom.

quests.question: A plumber fixes pipes and water, while a mechanic fixes cars and engines.
quests.hint: A plumber fixes pipes and water, while a mechanic fixes cars and engines.
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a plumber. Plumbers fix pipes so water flows where it should.
quests.funFact: A plumber can find a hidden leak just by listening carefully!
quests.wordExample: The plumber fixed the leaking pipe under the sink.

quests.question: A vet is a doctor for animals, while a farmer grows crops and raises animals for food.
quests.hint: A vet is a doctor for animals, while a farmer grows crops and raises animals for food.
quests.explanation: Correct! This is a vet. Vets take care of sick or hurt animals.
quests.funFact: Vets learn about many different animals, not just cats and dogs.
quests.wordExample: The vet gently checked the bird's wing.

quests.question: A writer writes many kinds of things, like stories or articles, while an author usually writes whole books.
quests.hint: A writer writes many kinds of things, like stories or articles, while an author usually writes whole books.
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a writer. Writers create stories, poems, and articles for people to read.
quests.funFact: A writer might imagine a whole new world before writing a single word!
quests.wordExample: The writer finished a new chapter of her story.

quests.question: A judge listens and decides what is fair, while a lawyer helps and speaks for one person in court.
quests.hint: A judge listens and decides what is fair, while a lawyer helps and speaks for one person in court.
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a judge. Judges listen carefully and decide what is fair in court.
quests.funFact: A judge listens to both sides of a story before deciding what is fair.
quests.wordExample: The judge listened carefully before making a decision.
